title: DOH AUTHORIZES REOPENING OF LEGEND SEAFOOD RESTAURANT IN HONOLULU
summary: HONOLULU — The Hawai‘i Department of Health (DOH) Food Safety Branch (FSB) issued Legend Seafood Restaurant a green placard and authorized the establishment’s reopening Oct. 2, 2026. The establishment, owned by Ming Dynasty Fish & Shrimp Co. and located at 100. N. Beretania St., Ste. 108, had received a red placard and was immediately closed […]
author: Kristen
title_norm: doh authorizes reopening of legend seafood restaurant in honolulu
